evidence.field: file description; source; license; file history
evidence.text: The Commons file page identifies 常-seal.svg as a vector rendering in Shuowen seal-script style, lists Sinica, Chinese Etymology, CUHK, Ctext, and Chinese Linguipedia as available source references, records a 2024 upload, and releases the SVG representation into the public domain. It is a modern digital drawing, not an ancient artifact image.
evidence.kind: historical-glyph image provenance and reuse record
evidence.title: File:常-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The entry describes 常 as a bronze graph with 巾 semantic and 尚 phonetic, gives a lower-body garment sense, and names bronze and Warring States manuscript uses. It also reports a bronze use for the customary-law sense and notes a competing flag-origin proposal. The entry provides no absolute dates for the named artifacts.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫

evidence.text: The inspected Commons category lists several unrelated character files and does not list a 常 image. It does not establish a usable Shang oracle-bone glyph candidate for 常.
evidence.title: Category:Shang oracle script characters - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The inspected category describes the Shang bronze file group but contains no 常-specific individual file on the opened page. It did not establish a candidate image for 常.

evidence.text: The inspected Chu slip category lists two files, neither a 常 glyph. It did not establish a 常-specific manuscript image candidate.

evidence.text: The inspected character category includes 常-seal.svg and 常-bronze.svg among its files. The listing establishes a Commons file entry for 常-bronze.svg, but the file description page could not be opened in this run, so its image source and reuse terms were not verified.

search_audit.query: Open the Commons 常-seal file page and inspect its original-file link and CUHK character analysis
search_audit.outcome: Opened both pages and inspected their actual contents. Commons page confirms Shuowen seal-style vector, source references, and public-domain release. CUHK entry gives formation and attestation claims.

search_audit.query: Click the original 常-seal file link and alternate-script links on Commons
search_audit.outcome: The direct SVG fetch returned a cache miss. Alternate-version links opened general script categories, not 常-specific files; inspected category contents and excluded them as image candidates.

Search confirmed the Commons file description and surfaced 常-bronze.svg in a Commons category listing. Opened the Wiktionary file page and Commons category pages; the Wikimedia upload target still failed to fetch.

search_audit.query: Open the 常-bronze.svg Commons file page listed in the category
search_audit.outcome: The file-page open returned a cache-miss error. Its provenance and rights could not be inspected, so it is excluded.

gaps: The source page provides a corrected direct target for 常-seal.svg, but the browser could not fetch the SVG itself; harness acquisition may still fail despite the page's valid file link.

常-bronze.svg appeared in a Commons category listing, but opening its file page failed with a cache miss. Its specific script period, source references, and reuse rights remain unverified, so it is not proposed.

Opened alternate-version links for oracle, bronze, and Chu-slip script led to broad categories and did not establish additional 常-specific images. No artifact photographs or visual inspection are claimed.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern vector file uploaded 2024-10-07, depicting a traditional script form
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 常 in Shuowen seal-script style. The file description identifies it as a traditional script form; it is not a photograph of an ancient inscription.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 常 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: This is the only opened 常-specific file page with clear identity, stated historical style, source references, and explicit public-domain release. It provides a visual counterpart to the received Shuowen account, though it does not show the graph's earliest form.
items.rights: Public domain; the Commons page states the creator released the SVG representation for any purpose.

limitations.text: The Commons page exposed the actual original-file URL, but the web fetch of that target failed with a cache miss. The previous 8/8b path in the acquisition record was a 404; this verified page link uses 8/8a. The image itself was not visually inspected.

常-bronze.svg was listed in a Commons category but its file page could not be opened, so source attribution, period details, and reuse rights were not established. It is therefore not included as a candidate.

Commons alternate-version links for oracle, bronze, and Chu-slip styles led to general categories without a 常-specific artifact image. No photographs of the named inscriptions were located in these inspected pages.
